name: dumbbell lying row on rack
description: A chest-supported row done lying face down on an incline bench or rack. With the body supported, it focuses the work on the upper back.
instructions: Lie face down on a raised bench with a dumbbell in each hand.
Let your arms hang straight down.
Row the weights up toward your ribs, elbows close to your body.
Squeeze your shoulder blades together at the top.
Lower slowly to full arm extension.
